notes: Current USMLE multisystem/metabolic outline supports inherited lipid-transport disorders.

Tangier Disease GeneReviews supports biallelic ABCA1 loss, transfer of cholesterol/phospholipid to apo A-I, nascent HDL formation, extremely low HDL, and reticuloendothelial cholesteryl-ester accumulation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Orange tonsils, nearly absent HDL, hepatosplenomegaly and biallelic ABCA1 loss identify Tangier disease; the direct defect is cholesterol/phospholipid efflux onto apo A-I.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: LDLR, MTTP, ABCG5/8 and NPC1 affect distinct lipid pathways and cannot explain the characteristic ABCA1/Tangier phenotype.
